200.description: Deviation - if the organization's IDP sync mode is not `UsersAndTeams` (i.e. group provisioning isn't enabled for that org/token), this returns 200 with an empty list rather than an error, masking the feature-flag state.

401.description: Missing/invalid bearer token, org mismatch, IDP sync disabled for the org, key ID mismatch, or key expired (verifyIdpKeyMiddleware in auth-service).
